qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Europe's leading monitored alarm provider with ~5M residential and small business subscribers generating predictable recurring subscription revenue with low churn (~7%) and contractual price escalation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). Entrenched European monitored residential alarm base with recurring subscription cash flows, but faces long-term disruption from DIY smart-home security ecosystems (Ring, Nest, Arlo) and high customer acquisition costs via door-to-door sales. GAAP ROIC of 1.6% reflects €13B+ in private equity buyout goodwill.
qualitative.evidence: Recurring revenues deliver ~25% adjusted EBIT margins and tangible ROIC >15% on subscriber hardware, but statutory GAAP ROIC is only 1.6% and FY2025 net income was -€256M due to €387M interest expense on €4.8B debt and €13.2B goodwill/intangibles. DIY smart cameras and wireless home automation create structural long-term substitution headwinds, restricting runway to 5 years.
